{{Quote|Get clear, Seven Three, so I can shoot him.|Unidentified stormtrooper to 73|<ref name="X:Bacta" />}}
'''73''' was the designation of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] stationed on the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. During the [[Bacta War]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], a short firefight ensued on the spaceport when another [[915|stormtrooper]] tried to arrest [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], who was under [[Corran Horn/Legends|disguise]]. 73 fell from an elevated walkway along with Horn during the course of the skirmish.<ref name="X:Bacta" />
